# ORCA fixture provenance

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Engine | ORCA |
| Version | 6.1.1 (RELEASE, linux x86-64 shared OpenMPI) |
| Command | `~/.local/bin/orca <job>.inp` |

## Real runs

`water-tddft.out` and `ethene-tddft.out` are **verbatim excerpts** of two real
ORCA 6.1.1 runs made on 2026-11-10, generated by `buildOrcaInput()` itself
(`jobType: 'TD-DFT'`, `tdStates: 5`, B3LYP/def2-SVP, `%pal nprocs 2`). The
retained lines are byte-identical to ORCA's output; only whole sections between
them were removed. No number was edited.

| Fixture | Molecule | Outcome | First root |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water-tddft.out` | H2O, 3 atoms | SCF converged in 8 cycles, E(SCF) = -76.32111959665978 Eh, 11 s | 7.584350 eV, 163.5 nm, f = 0.018099348 |
| `ethene-tddft.out` | C2H4, 6 atoms | SCF converged, E(SCF) = -78.47317204034394 Eh, 13 s | 8.136085 eV, 152.4 nm, f = 0.375187279 (pi->pi*) |

Both logs close with `CIS/TD-DFT TOTAL ENERGY` (`E(tot) = E(SCF) + DE(CIS)`,
Root 1) and print that total as `FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY`. The parser reports
the SCF energy as the final energy and keeps the decomposition in
`excitedStates.totalEnergy`.

Cross-check: the same B3LYP/def2-SVP water calculation in PySCF 2.15
(`tdscf.TDDFT`) gives 7.598 eV for the first root, 0.014 eV away; ethene gives
8.140 eV and f = 0.375 in PySCF against 8.136 eV and 0.3752 here.

**ORCA 6 does not accept a `TDDFT` (or `TD-DFT`) keyword on the simple input
line** — a 6.1.1 run stops with `UNRECOGNIZED OR DUPLICATED KEYWORD(S) IN SIMPLE
INPUT LINE`. The `%tddft` block alone switches the job on.

## Synthetic fixtures

`water-sp.out`, `water-opt-freq.out`, `failure-scf.out` and `not-orca.out` are
trimmed blocks in the documented ORCA format used by the parser, gate and
termination tests. They were written from the manual's examples, not captured
from a run.
